cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Take My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into your interpretation of a conflict involving a shared relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell Alex my alternating-weekend plan is fair. I taught you to see both sides; help our friend see mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We agreed all three of us would go every Saturday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've remembered the original plan. Now explain the improvement: sharing the workload instead of wearing out the friendship.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll speak to him if you admit you changed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I will. You're finally asking for a proper apology. After I give it, remind him why I changed the rota. You know how I taught you to explain an intention, not just a mistake.
